title: Pricing approval ladder, exception SLAs, and pricebook propagation playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an operational playbook for internal pricing governance that defines: the approval ladder for discounting and non-standard commercial terms; SLAs for decisioning on pricing exceptions; steps to update the canonical pricebook; how pricing experiments (packaging/discount trials) are gated; and which audit logs and artifacts are required for compliance and security questionnaires. This ticket synthesizes finance, legal, sales ops, and product inputs into a single source-of-truth playbook used by AMs and deal desk.
acceptance_criteria: A clear approval ladder with thresholds (self-serve, manager, VP+legal+finance) documented and agreed by Finance and Legal
Exception request form defined and hosted (Confluence + Request queue) with SLA targets
Pricebook update process documented end-to-end including source of truth, versioning, release notes, and rollback guidance
Linkable artifacts for each approval (signed approval emails or ticket IDs) stored for security questionnaire mapping
Communication plan and training checklist for Sales and AMs created
decisions: Adopt a tiered approval ladder based on net effective discount and term length
Use Confluence as canonical playbook and Google Sheet as transient experiment ledger; canonical pricebook will be persisted in the billing system (Stripe/Zuora) with version tags
Introduce a 48-hour SLA for standard exceptions and a 5-business-day SLA for high-complexity exceptions requiring legal review
next_steps: Review draft approval ladder with Finance (owner: Priya Raman) and Legal (owner: Daniel Ortega) by 2026-03-05
Prototype exception intake form and route to Request queue (Ops) by 2026-03-08
Run walkthrough w/ Sales AM cohort and update playbook language based on feedback (10 AMs) by 2026-03-12
Freeze initial pricebook propagation automation RFC for ENG to implement (ENG-3412) by 2026-03-18
comments: 2026-02-26 Aisha Patel: Drafted initial playbook after working session with Finance + Legal. Primary open question: threshold banding for term discounts vs. volume discounts.

2026-03-01 Priya Raman (Finance): Proposed numeric thresholds: <=10% CFO delegated to Sales Manager; 11-25% requires Revenue Ops + VP RevOps sign-off; >25% needs CFO + Legal. Asked for modeling of P&L impact for mid-market deals.

2026-03-03 Daniel Ortega (Legal): Legal can triage standard T&Cs exceptions in 3 business days; bespoke security addenda require 7-10 days. Suggested adding mandatory checklist item linking to customer security questionnaire (SQ) responses.

2026-03-04 Marco Li (Assignee): Added propagation steps for pricebook: (1) update Confluence + sheet, (2) create billing system draft change, (3) QA in sandbox, (4) release with version tag. Flagged edge case: concurrent experiments may cause conflicting pricebook entries — proposed experiment ledger lock.

2026-03-06 Sales Ops (Nora Kim): Requested exception SLA for inbound renewals where churn risk is high — proposed expedited 24-hour triage path with delegated authority to AM Director for up to 15% net concession.

2026-03-08 Marco Li: Incorporated Sales Ops expedited path and created sample Exception Intake form (link above). Added required artifacts list for each exception: business case, financial model export, Legal checklist, AM endorsement.
2026-03-09 Product (Aisha): Ran 1:1 with two AMs; UX on intake form is fine but requested automated notifications to Slack deal-desk channel when requests are opened. Added to next_steps for ENG RFC.
2026-03-10 Finance (Priya): Completed P&L modelling for suggested thresholds and validated that 25% cap keeps unit economics within target for targeted segments. Approve moving to In Review.
